title: chaosD6 skill definition (chaosd6.skill/1, chaosd6.skill/2) and skill library (chaosd6.skill-lib/1)
description: Structural schema. Semantic checks (known hooks, known operations of the skill vocabulary, known subroutines, JS markers only on built-ins) are done by skill-engine.mjs#validateSkillDef / validateSkillLib (skills.mjs#validateSkillDef); see SCHEMA.md.

logic.description: A program in the effects' JsonLogic dialect (effects-data/SCHEMA.md): a primitive, an array (evaluated element-wise) or an object with exactly ONE key (the operation).

jsMarker.description: The hook stays in JS (built-in skills only): impl names the function (skills.mjs#… or peer.mjs#…).

schema.description: /2 = built-in (deal_order, card, ui); /1 still loads (foreign skills, not dealt).

source.description: Where the metadata came from (data/skills.json active version) — provenance only.

deal_order.description: /2 built-ins: position in the deal order (SKILLS_IMPLEMENTED; every "in deal order" fold). Unique; a /1 skill has none (not dealt).

action_type.description: The action card it rides on (M / P also ride on EM / EP).

point_buy_stat.description: Rule 12 / 24 stat of a permanent; null for an instant.

fixed_power.description: Permanent only: lands with this Rule 24 power, no point-buy roll (Force Shield = 6, ruling 2026-11-16).

resources.description: /1 (foreign) only, 2026-11-23: the skill's picture and sound from chaosD6-Resources — the shape of an effect's card.resources. Not priced. A /2 built-in keeps them in card.resources.

flags.description: Two vocabularies in one object (SCHEMA.md): the resolver flags = skills.mjs SKILL_RULES[id] (action, permanent, pointBuyStat, negating, hooks, range, negates, keepsTarget, trance, attackBonus, damageOff) and the S5 validator's priced flags (FLAG_KEYS: attackBonus, damageOff, negate, altCounterSkill, counterSkill, counterElement, trance, blockImmune, trapImmune, tauntGuard, immuneTo, restInvincible, effectShield). Data-only additions (/2): passOrder {<pass hook>: n} = position in that pass hook's order (skill-engine.mjs HOOK_SPECS order is derived from it); buildingSkill = 0-based index in the building-bonus skill list (part of the (seed,q,r) contract); planLock = codes array of a paid plan lock (unused by the built-ins: Powerful Attack's selfLock.codes says it).

uses.description: Library ids whose subroutines `call` may use (searched in order).

ui.description: Presentation (/2): tag = two-letter chip tag, glyph/color = floating icon, card_glyph/card_color = hover-card override where it differs, rest_hint = Empty Posture slot hint while resting under this skill.

card.description: The data-layer card (/2), copied from data/skills.json's active version: name/tags/resources of the entry, data/rebalance_links/logic of the version. card.data must equal the top-level action_type / is_permanent / point_buy_stat / text (+ element, fixed_power).

defaults.description: hook → sub: the program of a per-skill hook (rides, plan_target, perm_landing, perm_stats, disposition) for a skill without its own.
